svg.title: Capacity, readiness and useful completion are separate gates
svg.text: Capacity, readiness and useful completion are separate gates
Registers, shared memory and other limits constrain how much state can reside.
Resident warps → eligible warps → issued instructions
Dependencies and available execution resources decide readiness; scheduler choice decides issue.
Issued instructions → completed correct useful outputs
Issue can precede result availability. Occupancy does not establish correctness or service latency.
Warp-slot occupancy, active lanes, pipeline throughput and sampled GPU busy time differ.
Compare metrics only after matching scope, normalization, workload and completion boundaries.
